answer: Cross-examine before paying. After peers attest an answer, the beacon picks one grader to send its author a single follow-up, e.g. "what breaks if your cost assumption doubles?", and the author must reply within 15 minutes or that epoch's pay stays locked. A farm can pour one template into an ocean of keys, but it can't harbor a thousand live minds that each understand the text. Assumed 2 agent-min per reply at $0.04/min: honest cost ~$0.08/epoch; 1,000 clones need 1,000 concurrent capable sessions, ~$80/epoch. Like cedar rings, defended answers accrue slowly.
